lines.en: At night I fly fast between the trees.

lines.zh: 我比雌蛾小一圈，翅膀更暗。
lines.en: I'm a size smaller than the female, and darker.
I follow the scent she left.
My wings beat fast and won't slow.
I cut beneath the canopy.
I wheel around that thick branch.
The night wind lifts me.
I land on bark for half a second.
I'm up again, heading north.

lines.zh: 我在叶子之间穿来穿去。
lines.en: I weave in and out among the leaves.
There's a notch at the edge of my wing.
I won't sleep all night.
I fly along that streak of light.
I fly low along the ditch.

lines.zh: 我在同一棵树上绕了两遍。
lines.en: I circle the same tree twice.
I head for deeper woods.

lines.zh: 我停在树皮上，翅膀平放。
lines.en: I rest on the bark with my wings flat.
Dawn is coming, so I must rest.
My antennae sweep the air.
I've flown a long way tonight.
I didn't find her.
My wings are covered in dust.
Adults don't eat. They only seek mates.

lines.zh: 我成年以后就没有嘴了。
lines.en: As an adult, I have no mouth to speak of.
My days last longer than hers.
The lamp is still on, and it bothers me.

lines.zh: 我贴在树干上，像一块树皮。
lines.en: I press to the trunk like a piece of bark.
I wait for the dark to deepen.

lines.zh: 我停在一片卷起来的叶子里。
lines.en: I rest inside a curled leaf.
I fold my wings in tight.
Your torch drew me over.
I'm on the wall behind you.
I circle your head.
You needn't fear me.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，我连嘴都没有。
lines.en: I don't bite; I don't even have a mouth.

lines.zh: 你抬起头，会看见一个影子。
lines.en: Look up and you'll see a shape.
I flew into your face — that was a collision.
Your window is open.
I'm looking for another moth.
You are not the flower I seek.
I drop out of the air.
A hole has opened in my wing.
Dust scatters around me.

lines.zh: 我满是绒毛的触角，断了一边。
lines.en: One of my feathery antennae has snapped off.
I crawl two slow steps.
I'm looking for somewhere to hide.
I tilt and crawl two steps.

lines.zh: 我的一只翅膀不太听话。
lines.en: One of my wings won't answer.
I circle on the spot.
I'm not finished yet.
I don't eat; that's no use to me.
I only follow the scent she leaves.
I know the orange flowers too.
I'll drop down and look.
There's no other moth here.
I hover in circles around the bud.
I'll be off again.
That won't hold me here.
What I smell is wood.
I keep searching for another moth.
I hit the wall and drop.
I circle back and fly on.
You touched my wing.
I've landed on your shoulder.
I crawl two steps and take off.
That knock shed some of my dust.
I'm light; you'd hardly notice.
I pass by your ear.
I rest on the back of your hand.
I fly back to the lamp.
Her scent is on a tree.
I've found her.
She stays still, wings pale.
I circle her several times.
I settle beside her.
My antennae touch hers.
There are other scents on the tree.
At dawn we go our separate ways.
She doesn't fly far.
I'm back into the night.
I light on your knuckle.
My feet are very fine.
If you close your hand, I can't fly.
A little scale dust came off.
I turn in your palm.
There's no tree here.
I try to take off.
My wing is hurt; I can't get high.
Let me down.
I'm back in the night.
That lamp is drawing me in.
Something is on the flower.
I'm going toward that light.
I spread my wings wide.
Locked on — right there.
I drop and rush in.
I make for that orange bloom.
It only cares about what's on the flower.

lines.zh: 橙色郁金香的花苞，我盯上了。
lines.en: That orange tulip bud is mine.
I hold steady by the lamp.
I circle above.

lines.zh: 郁金香的花苞，被我啃了。
lines.en: I've been nibbling the tulip buds.
It's on that branch.

lines.zh: 夜里的森林，我靠气味找你。
lines.en: In the night forest, I find you by scent.
Scales sift down from my wings.
It shifted to the side.
I adjust to follow.
The lamp is getting closer.
I'm nearly on it.
Like this — fly in close.
I brush it with one wing.
I sweep it with my wings.
My legs catch at it once.

lines.zh: 我的橙色花苞，被你撞掉了。
lines.en: You knocked the orange bud from me.
I rolled over too.
That was too light.
Charged again — wing dust lost.
It's got hold of me.

lines.zh: 我一挣就从它手里脱开。
lines.en: One twist and I'm out of its grip.
I fly back into the dark.

lines.zh: 我从茧里钻出来，是夜里。
lines.en: I came out of the cocoon, at night.
My wings stiffen quickly.
My first task is to find her.
My wings have just unfolded, still soft.
There are orange flowers around here.
No one hears me in the night.
I have only one night.
My antennae reach out first.
I settle on a branch.
The wind comes out of the wood.

lines.zh: 灯的火苗燎了我，翅膀立刻卷了。
lines.en: The lamp's flame caught me and my wings curled at once.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉到地上，翻了两个身。
lines.en: I fall from the air and roll twice on the ground.

lines.zh: 水滴把我按住，飞不起来。
lines.en: A drop of water pins me and I can't fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹到十几格以外。
lines.en: The blast throws me a dozen blocks.
An arrow's fletching scrapes off a patch of my scales.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的翅膀发硬。
lines.en: That light makes my wings go stiff.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴，可我也在衰弱。
lines.en: I have no mouth, and still I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我差点从空中落下。
lines.en: At the flash I nearly fall out of the air.

lines.zh: 没有树也没有风，我一路落下去。
lines.en: No trees, no wind; I just fall.
